purpose: Automatic unique UV charts and packing with native overlap, base-padding and first-mip padding observation
limitations: Runtime backend: Blender 4.3+. Explicit local installation; no automatic downloads.
A PASS requires enough measured atlas/island padding to retain at least one pixel after the first 2x mip reduction; deeper safe levels are conservatively reported, not universally guaranteed.
This does not prove target-engine sampler behavior, anisotropic filtering, compression behavior or every possible mip level.
Bounded technical evidence only. No automatic product or artistic acceptance.
